title: Initial continuous RAW editing — Nikon Z6, Fujifilm X100VI and DJI Air 2S
objective: Deliver continuously editable, non-destructive RAW recipes for Nikon Z6, Fujifilm X100VI and the qualified DJI Air 2S DNG mode, with preserved originals, retained precision, neutral exposure/WB, composition/history and shared UI/API behavior. Broader scene/resource/platform qualification remains explicit. Integrate JPEG output through the separately delivered exporter.
context_summary: Continuous RAW implementation is authorized. LibRaw0.22.2 and pinned librtprocess RCD/Markesteijn1 provide one static production path. Qualified NEF/RAF/DNG editing retains sensor data and float32 linear sRGB through the recipe, with terminal display conversion. The Air 2S work is on codex/mavic-air2s-dng under docs/design/air2s-dng.md: required gain/warp corrections, fixed D65 calibration, independent references and continuous editor integration are implemented. It inherits the existing unclipped scene-headroom contract; strict Adobe per-opcode clipping is not claimed. Owner originals and four public mode samples remain ignored. Code delivery and controlled scene/platform/resource qualification are separate: missing charts, hosted native targets and accepted performance budgets cannot be inferred from supplied-file tests. JPEG Basic/export/Locate/MCP remain separate; TASK-021 requires the absent shared exporter and does not block editing.

tasks.description: Establish the initial authentic camera-mode corpus, integrity manifests and explicit coverage gaps.
extra_context: The owner supplied nikon_z6.NEF, fujifilm_x100vi.RAF and mavic_air_2s.DNG for local implementation. Originals are ignored and never redistributed; fixture hashes are in the ignored owner manifest.

Initial mode acquisition is complete: owner Z6 14-bit lossless, X100VI 14-bit uncompressed and DJI FC3411 DNG1.4 uncompressed16-bit storage; public CC0 Z6 12/14-bit lossless and X100VI uncompressed/lossless supplement them. Source-integrity evidence passes for all seven files.

ExifTool13.59 supplies independent metadata. Coverage is inventory only, not supported-camera qualification; controlled quality scenes and additional modes remain explicit gaps to resolve in TASK-005.

tasks.description: Freeze proposed source, processing, job and Basic integration interfaces against the delivered editor.
extra_context: M4 number controls, layer updates, crop and workspace are implemented. JPEG Basic has decided product choices and is the selected next priority but is not implemented; export, Locate and MCP remain separately owned follow-ups.
The owner requires ongoing RAW recipes, not conversion to a JPEG or byte raster for later editing. Interface proposals must carry high precision through the whole editing stack.

Concrete code-path, source-stage, job/completion, Basic ownership and allocation proposal is in docs/design/raw-integration.md. This completes the interface-design task, not the production implementation or selection gate.

tasks.description: Measure full-editor RAW responsiveness, memory and JPEG regressions on the owner's M4.
extra_context: Provisional time/RSS targets are investigation hypotheses until the owner accepts measured budgets. Do not hide misses by changing input modes or quietly enabling embedded previews.

The implemented raw-editor command records whole-editor edit/history/reopen distributions and sampled process RSS. Fine-grained stage, GPU, cancellation and idle attribution remain separate outstanding work; JPEG baselines use editor-performance.

Thirty complete native M4 trials per owner camera and four public mode workflows pass. The same 24/60 MP JPEG core diagnostic is recorded before/after. Fuji captured RSS p95 is 1992 MiB with an unexplained 2436 MiB maximum; screenshot-free peaks are 1583–1647 MiB. Fine-grained stage/GPU/cancellation/idle attribution and an accepted budget remain open.

Measurement depends on the implemented editor, not on completion of broad controlled-scene/fuzz/portability gates. Those gates remain independently open. RSS sampling includes renderer/capture effects and must not be relabelled as isolated CPU heap or GPU memory.
